faqs.title: Frequently asked questions
faqs.subtitle: Everything you need to know to get started with FocusPond.

what-is.question: What is FocusPond?
what-is.answer: FocusPond is your quiet corner of the internet to plan, focus, and feel less overwhelmed. It's a calm productivity space with tools like a Pomodoro timer, daily tasks, Frog of the Day, and gentle mood check-ins, all designed to help you work with ease, not pressure.

is-free.question: Is FocusPond free?
is-free.answer: Yes, FocusPond is completely free while we're in our early stage. You'll always have access to the essentials, even when premium features arrive later.

offline.question: Does it work offline?
offline.answer: Yes, you can use FocusPond even without internet access. Your data is safely stored on your device and will sync online when you create an account.

frog-of-day.question: What is the 'Frog of the Day'?
frog-of-day.answer: Your Frog of the Day is the most important task you choose to tackle first. It's not about urgency, it's about doing the one thing that'll make your day feel productive and calm.

identify-frog.question: How do I identify a 'Frog task'?
identify-frog.answer: A Frog task is the one you've been putting off, usually because it feels big or important. It should take around 1 to 4 hours. If it feels overwhelming, break it into smaller steps and start with the first one.

no-account.question: Can I use FocusPond without creating an account?
no-account.answer: Yes. You can start using FocusPond right away without signing up, everything you do is saved on your device. Creating an account later just lets you back up your progress and sync across devices.

vibe-switcher.question: What is the vibe switcher?
vibe-switcher.answer: It lets you choose how the app talks to you and in which language, calm and formal in English, relaxed in Naijá (Pidgin), or in Igbo, Yorùbá, Hausa, or French. Pick the vibe that matches your mood for the day.
